brief: Loads the declared world of a project, its symbols and the references between them, and says whether every reference resolves.
detail: A world artifact is one derived JSON file with two flat tables: the symbols each court declares, with kind, name and span, and the references between them. The class reads it and never writes it, collects every refusal as a diagnostic instead of raising on the first, and hands back an ordinary stzGraph with one node per symbol and one edge per referenced pair. Kinds are a closed set, ids are the lower-case kind:name, and two symbols that differ only by case are refused. IsLawful is the gate. The class is not loaded by stzlib.ring: load graph/stzWorldGraph.ring first.
